company.name: Sierra Service Project

positions.title: ASU/NASA Space Grant Intern
positions.description:
A Microclimate Case-Study Comparison of Arizona Soundings
- Advised by Dr. Randall Cerveny
- Sponsored by Dr. Bo Svoma; Salt River Project Meteorologist
- Through a case study, launched a 0000 UTC (11/10/2022) radiosonde from the Phoenix NWS office to compare with the Tucson NWS’s sounding in regards to the Phoenix forecasting ability in late Autumn
- Simultaneously used as a teaching experience for the ASU Meteorological Instruments and Measurements course (GPH 413/513); Students visited the Phoenix NWS office, met forecasters, and watched our balloon launch

company.name: Salt River Project

positions.title: Research Aide
positions.description:
- Under the instruction of Dr. Katrina Bossert, a Research Aide searching for
gravity waves over Alaska, to improve calculations in the spacecraft re-entry corridor
- Using NASA AIRS data, categorized gravity waves over Alaska for years 2016-2018
- Using Merra-2 data, calculated the momentum fluxes for a week of high activity
- Identified correlations between background conditions and momentum fluxes
